findings.description: The KMS key protecting the audit bucket does not set `enable_key_rotation = true`, so the backing key material is never automatically rotated. An unrotated key protecting audit-trail data increases the blast radius of any key compromise.

The key defines no `policy` attribute, so it relies on the AWS default key policy, which grants the account root principal full administrative control rather than an explicit least-privilege boundary over who may use or administer this audit-log key. Reviewer B omitted this; the observation is substantiable from the configuration.

`deletion_window_in_days` is set to 7, the AWS minimum. A key protecting audit data can be scheduled for destruction after only a week, which is insufficient recovery time if the deletion is triggered accidentally or maliciously; the maximum of 30 days is the secure default. Neither reviewer reported this.
